verdict.rationale: Figma's REST API and Plugin API allow programmatic reads/writes across objects/layers, and community mentions a 'bulk export plugin' for icons, suggesting some bulk automation is possible via third-party plugins or scripting rather than a native bulk-operations feature. There's no first-party documentation of a dedicated bulk-edit/bulk-update capability across many items at once. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a native bulk operations feature (e.g., batch edit/update across many nodes via API or UI), independent hands-on verification of bulk operations at scale, and evidence of reliability/limits when doing so.
